The move to Not configured happens only when ForgetKeyClearance (190-195) follows straight away, as at PolicyProcessing 250-251 and EditPol 220-221. Say that in the lifecycle or the transition: the purge is two calls, writtenAt should reach the pair (or the lines that call both), and the Key cleared text should name the purge path. The REG states are right, but the lifecycle never says the REG store is only an export target: RegFile's own comment says it is not a valid policy source for any loader, ContainsValue/GetValue/WillDeleteValue/GetValueNames/ForgetValue throw NotImplementedException, and it is filled only by Source.Apply(reg) in ExportReg 28-29. State this where the REG store is named (stateFields or the states' text) so a reader does not treat a REG file as a store that is read back. Also transition-08502660900567048035 omits state 4 while the POL SetValue includes it: RegFile.SetValue (226-236) after ClearKey adds a second, non-deleter key beside the deleter key, so from 4 the file holds cleared-and-configured; say so or add 4.
